title: 第3章 收徒陆玄合第4章 禁忌剑体
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
火！
无穷无尽的火！
一座府邸已被火海笼罩，一群黑衣人正在肆无忌惮地屠杀着。
无数的尸体倒在地上，这些人死法各异，上面有着剑伤、刀伤，有的人甚至头颅不翼而飞。
家主院子中。
“爹！”
一个八岁左右的孩童大声呼喊着，身旁一名年约三十的美妇人正将其护着。
不远处，一名威武不凡的中年人手持长剑，带领数位护卫联手抵抗这群黑衣人。
但是，随着时间推移，中年人身边不断有护卫倒下，自己身上也多出了数道伤口。
......
“你们这群畜生，烧我陆家府邸，屠我族人！”
看到这一幕，陆玄合咬牙切齿，神色狰狞，身体颤抖得不停，双眼赤红得仿佛要喷出火来。
......
画面再次一转。
孩童被一道淡青色的灵力罩笼罩。
他身旁的美妇人加入到远处战场，与中年男子一同对敌。
夫妻俩以及身旁仅存的几位护卫纷纷燃烧自身灵力，身上发出耀眼的光芒，试图自爆。
二人转过身来，朝孩童深深的望了过去，这一眼包含了对孩子无尽的不舍、眷念与牵挂。
那孩童似乎明白了什么，手脚不断扑打的同时呼喊着爹娘。
最后，一道惊天动地的响声传开，孩童被灵力罩护着穿梭空间遁向远方。

......
画面就此消失。
“畜生，你们这群畜生！
我一定会找到你们身后之人，将他碎尸万段！”
见此，陆玄合神色狰狞地可怕，似狱中恶鬼般。
“扑哧！”
他吐出一口鲜血，体内气息紊乱，灵力开始乱窜，境界竟然也随之破碎，开始下跌，整个人状态萎靡至极，最后昏死过去
走火入魔！
这赫然是心境破碎，气急攻心导致的。
轰！
陆玄合考核失败，被送出考核之地。
“嗯？不好！”
刚才的那位长老，赶紧扶起陆玄合。
一手拿出一粒清心丹未入口中，一手抵在其后背，运转灵力进去陆玄合体内，助其炼化丹药。
不多时，陆玄合缓缓醒来，睁开双眼，眼前之人正是之前那位长老。
他顿时明白了一切，虚弱地站起身，双手作揖对着那位长老道：“多谢长老疗伤。”
“无妨，小事而已。
只是小友出现如此情况，考核算是失败了。”
content_en:
fire!
Endless fire!
A mansion has been shrouded in flames, and a group of men in black are slaughtering them wantonly.
Countless corpses fell to the ground. These people died in different ways, with sword wounds and knife wounds, and some even had their heads missing.
In the owner’s yard.
"Dad!"
A child of about eight years old shouted loudly, and a beautiful woman of about thirty years old was protecting him next to him.
Not far away, a mighty middle-aged man holding a long sword led several guards to join forces to resist the group of men in black.
However, as time passed, guards continued to fall around the middle-aged man, and he also received several wounds on his body.
...
"You bunch of beasts, burn down my Lu family's mansion and slaughter my people!"
Seeing this scene, Lu Xuanhe gritted his teeth, looked ferocious, his body was shaking non-stop, and his eyes were so red that they seemed to be spitting out fire.
...
The screen changed again.
The child was shrouded in a light blue spiritual power.
The beautiful woman beside him joined the distant battlefield and faced the enemy with the middle-aged man.
The couple and the few remaining guards around them burned their spiritual power, emitted a dazzling light, and tried to self-destruct.
The two turned around and looked deeply at the child. This look contained endless reluctance, nostalgia and concern for the child.
The child seemed to understand something. He kept beating his hands and feet while calling for his parents.
Finally, an earth-shattering sound spread, and the child was protected by spiritual power and fled through the space into the distance.
...
The screen disappears.
“Beasts, you bunch of beasts!
I will definitely find the person behind you and cut him into pieces! "
Seeing this, Lu Xuanhe looked ferocious and terrifying, like a ghost in prison.
"Puch!"
He spit out a mouthful of blood, the aura in his body was disordered, and his spiritual power began to flow around. His realm also shattered and began to fall. His whole body was extremely depressed, and he finally passed out.
Obsessed!
This was clearly caused by a broken heart and a state of anger.
boom!
Lu Xuanhe failed the assessment and was sent out of the assessment place.
"Huh? Not good!"
The elder just now quickly helped Lu Xuanhe up.
He took out a Qingxin Pill with one hand and put it in his mouth. He put his other hand on his back and used his spiritual power to enter Lu Xuanhe's body to help him refine the pill.
Not long after, Lu Xuanhe woke up slowly and opened his eyes. The person in front of him was the elder from before.
He understood everything immediately, stood up weakly, bowed his hands and said to the elder: "Thank you, elder, for healing your wounds."
“It doesn’t matter, it’s just a small matter.
It's just that if this happens to the kid, the assessment will be considered a failure. "
